relief.hypothesis: if puck 6 seats by thumb and puck 3 at the same diameter does not, the problem was engagement length, not diameter, and the real pocket should be relieved

how_to_judge: use the SAME bearing in every puck, in order, and put it in and out twice -- a pocket that is right the first time and loose the second is shaving, not fitting
the one you want goes in with steady thumb pressure and does not fall out when you turn the puck over and tap it
if two adjacent pucks both feel right, take the smaller
if NONE of 1-5 feel right but 6 does, tell me and I will relieve the pocket in the real part rather than chase the diameter any further
then give me the dot count and I will set the constant from it once, with the measurement written down
